root_action: Read the complete four-page proof and full distinct uniform mathematical review; freshly checked all exports and source/library bindings.
scope: The uniform strict quarter lower bounds in every stated classical family, and the exact PSU4(q) involution formula for q=3 modulo4. This corrects the source special half-bound; the principal existence theorem is not thereby refuted.
proof_review: Ambient matrix orbits remain in the required special subgroup; scalar fusion costs at most two and costs one for unequal eigenspaces. The balanced and square-minus-identity constructions cover the parity cases.

The self-adjoint nilpotent counts give the characteristic-two unitary classes; the nonalternating symmetric form stabilizers give the symplectic classes. Each matrix construction, radical exponent and determinant condition is paid.

Orthogonal spinor and Dickson membership is explicit. The invariant-quadratic-form double count splits signs equally using a free Arf coefficient. The chosen ranks produce the claimed uniform constants.

The PSU4 formula exhausts lifts whose square is in mu4. Order-eight eigenvalues contribute only for q=7 modulo8, with the stated determinant condition and scalar fusion. The resulting strict failure of q^8/2 is uniform; it does not negate the source quarter bound.

distinct_replay.additional_no_author_import_controls: Eight I_k isometry groups over F2/F4, and scalar-fusion families in eleven fields.
